summary: Implemented custom global generators in the cache extensions/generators folder. Changes: (1) conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER = "generators" and a generators_path property. (2) conans/client/generators/__init__.py: _get_generator_class falls back to _get_custom_generator_class when the name is not built in, loading <generators_path>/<name>.py via load_python_file and returning the class of the same name; built-ins keep priority; the invalid-generator error lists custom files too; write_generators accepts an optional custom_generators_path. (3) conans/client/installer.py passes self._cache.generators_path at both write_generators call sites. Nothing was run or tested, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Docs and changelog from the spec are not included.
